name: Easel Row
summary: An art marketplace landing page with a deck of painted cards that fans out, shuffles and swipes
about: An editorial one-page site for an art marketplace, gallery or creative platform. A deck of seven generative paintings deals itself into a fan; drag, swipe or tap to bring a work forward, or shuffle to re-deal. Collectors and artists each get their own view, and the featured works filter by medium with wishlist hearts and a make-an-offer dialog.
how: The cards rise, fan out like a hand and flip face up one by one; hover lifts a card and the front card tilts with the pointer
Drag or swipe the deck, use the arrows or arrow keys, or tap a card to bring it to the centre with its title, artist and price
Press Shuffle: the deck gathers, riffles twice and deals a new order
Switch between For collectors and For artists to swap the copy and the drawn scene
Filter the featured works by medium, save favourites to the wishlist, and Make an offer: the dialog checks the amount and email, then stamps it sent
Scroll for the artist marquee, the drawn selling timeline, count-up numbers and the giant footer wordmark
